apps.name: Clearline
apps.subtitle: Private offline-first task management for iPhone and Windows.
apps.localizedDescription: Clearline is a private, offline-first task manager with native iPhone integrations, widgets and controls, Share Sheet capture, Shortcuts/App Intents, reminders, calendar interoperability, and encrypted cross-device synchronization.

versions.localizedDescription: Web-embedded physical-iPhone retest candidate. Built from dual-green source commit e7e64d2101c7e04d90acc1faf8e05f7a104cce04. Main app www/index.html and compiled assets, Widgets/Controls metadata, and Share extension metadata all passed remote artifact gates and direct IPA inspection before publication.
